map.输入初始铬浓度、废液铬浓度、皮重与液比，计算铬吸收率与吸收量: Enter the initial chromium concentration, the waste liquor chromium concentration, hide weight and liquor ratio to compute the chromium uptake rate and the amount absorbed
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：(c0-c1)×liq÷1e6: Core formula (in terms of input variables): (c0-c1)×liq÷1e6
map.📖 查看「鞣制铬吸收率 使用指南」: 📖 Read the Tanning Chromium Uptake user guide
map.💡 吸收率 = (初始−废液) ÷ 初始 × 100%；液量 = 皮重 × 液比: 💡 Uptake rate = (initial − waste liquor) ÷ initial × 100%; liquor volume = hide weight × liquor ratio; chromium absorbed = (initial − waste liquor) × liquor volume ÷ 10⁶
map.吸收率反映铬鞣剂利用率: The uptake rate reflects how well the chrome tanning agent is used
map.提高吸收率可降低废液铬污染: Raising the uptake rate reduces chromium pollution in the waste liquor
map.常用提碱手段提高吸收率: Raising the pH near the end is the common way to improve uptake
map.按鞣制前后浴液铬浓度差计算铬吸收率，评估铬鞣效率与化工材料利用率。: Compute the chromium uptake rate from the difference in bath chromium concentration before and after tanning, to assess chrome tanning efficiency and chemical utilization.
map.按液量与浓度差算出被皮吸收的铬质量，用于物料衡算。: Use the liquor volume and concentration difference to get the mass of chromium absorbed by the hide, for material balance.
map.通过提碱、升温等手段提高吸收率，降低废液铬污染与处理成本。: Improve the uptake rate by raising the pH and the temperature, reducing chromium waste and treatment cost.
map.铬吸收率(%) = (初始浓度 − 废液浓度) ÷ 初始浓度 × 100%；液量: Chromium uptake rate (%) = (initial concentration − waste concentration) ÷ initial concentration × 100%; liquor volume (L) = hide weight × liquor ratio; chromium absorbed (kg) = (initial concentration − waste concentration) × liquor volume ÷ 1,000,000 (concentration in mg/L). Grades: ≥80% excellent, ≥60% good, ≥40% average, otherwise poor.
map.初始铬浓度 8000 mg/L、废液 1600 mg/L：吸收率 = (8000: Initial chromium concentration 8000 mg/L, waste liquor 1600 mg/L: uptake rate = (8000−1600)/8000×100 = 80%, rated excellent. Hide weight 200 kg with a liquor ratio of 1.0 gives liquor volume 200 L, and chromium absorbed = 6400×200/1e6 = 1.28 kg.
map.如何提高铬吸收率？: How do I raise the chromium uptake rate?
map.常用手段包括后期提碱（提高 pH 促进铬络合）、适当升温、延长鞣制时间与减小液比: Common means are raising the pH near the end (higher pH promotes chromium complexing), raising the temperature appropriately, extending the tanning time and reducing the liquor ratio; a higher uptake rate cuts both cost and chromium waste.
map.吸收量为什么要除以一百万？: Why is the absorbed amount divided by one million?
map.浓度以 mg/L 计、液量以 L 计，相乘得 mg；除以 10⁶ 即换算为 kg: Concentration is in mg/L and volume in L, so the product is in mg; dividing by 10⁶ converts it to kg (1 kg = 10⁶ mg), hence the formula concentration difference × volume/10⁶.
map.鞣制铬吸收率计算工具根据鞣液初始铬浓度与废液铬浓度，结合皮重与液比，计算铬吸收率: The Tanning Chromium Uptake calculator uses the initial and waste liquor chromium concentrations together with hide weight and liquor ratio to compute the chromium uptake rate and the amount absorbed, helping optimize the tanning process, raise chromium utilization and reduce pollution.
map.吸收率与吸收量同时计算: Uptake rate and absorbed amount computed together
